_comment: Copy to profile.json (or pass --profile). Run `python mapgen.py resolve --write` to fill every id from the names. Credentials are NOT stored here: auth names the environment variables (or a KEY=VALUE envFile) that hold them. These entries are examples of connectors, not recommendations: keep only the ones you use, add your own, and set 'kind' on every one (no kind = treated as BigQuery, lint warns CONN_KIND_MISSING); each needs its own placeholders until resolve fills them (two equal placeholders fail lint). SNOW and DBX lint with WARN CONN_KIND: expected (generic adapter path).

guards._comment: regexes. lint and deploy refuse matching folders / targets unless --allow-live. Targets are matched as '<object>', '<alias>:<object>' and '<connection name>:<object>'. busyTaskPrefixes: runs wait while tasks with these name prefixes are running on the shared agent. Add one protectedTargets pattern for EVERY connection alias you write to (for example '^ORA:(?!<scratch schema>/)' or '^FF:(?!<scratch file prefix>)'): a target on an alias with no pattern is not protected.
